claim: The packaged-desktop UI can guide a user to a pending Full Harness consent or authentication surface and can visualize workstation MCP engagement without executing the highlighted control or gaining authority.
positive_evidence: Start Harness requests an Agent Access panel open and a bounded spotlight on the exact Full Harness trust control when device trust is absent.
An inactive client authorization routes attention to the account-link surface and its user-triggered native Auth0 window.
A workstation panel action emits a short-lived view-only engagement highlight before normal ledgered execution.
The overlay scrolls the registered target into the viewport and exposes an aria-live status label.
The existing transition-request MCP operation can ask the protected native broker to show, restore, focus, and highlight the exact Agent Access trust target without requiring a new catalog tool.

A live packaged request desktop_tunnel_request:a9592741-3a4f-4906-81ba-ef64c43b2691 presented the correct control; the operator visibly confirmed the foreground/highlight behavior and then independently enabled trust.

The exact transition receipt chain advanced requested -> delegated -> transition_accepted -> expired. The accepted native transport cut lost its HTTP response, but no duplicate execute was issued; after lease rollback the same request remained inspectable with its hash chain intact.
negative_evidence: The guidance overlay has pointer-events disabled and never invokes click on the highlighted element.
Malformed guidance kinds are rejected and target identifiers are reduced to bounded selector-independent tokens.
Guidance does not approve OAuth, update trusted-device policy, delegate a tunnel lease, execute an environment action, or gain answer or terminal authority.
Tool-activity text explicitly states that the highlight is view-only and implies no authority.

packaged_runtime_health.basis: Fresh packaged process reached express app ready; protected account session, Helix pipeline, and agent-provider routes each responded HTTP 401 to an unauthenticated loopback probe, while the authenticated renderer recorded HTTP 200 for those routes.

packaged_onboarding_smoke.reason: Repository guard requires at least 4 GiB free physical memory; measured free physical memory was 2.97 GiB. The guard was preserved.

assertions: MCP presenter invoked without changing transition receipt authority
renderer overlay never clicks the target
